parameters.query: WITH today AS (SELECT to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day), sessions_today AS (SELECT s.id, s.device_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.name,''),'(이름없음)') AS name, (s.input_tokens*32.0 + s.output_tokens*64.0)/1e6 AS cost_usd FROM care_sessions s LEFT JOIN care_profiles p ON p.device_id=s.device_id WHERE (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date), device_daily AS (SELECT device_id, MAX(name) AS name, SUM(cost_usd) AS day_cost FROM sessions_today GROUP BY device_id), global_daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd),0) AS total FROM sessions_today), candidates AS (SELECT 'device:'||device_id||':'||(SELECT day FROM today)||':daily' AS alert_key, 1.0::numeric AS threshold, day_cost AS value, '⚠️ '||name||' 단말기 일일 사용 비용이 임계를 넘었습니다.'||chr(10)||'누적 $'||ROUND(day_cost::numeric,3)||' (임계 $1.00) · 단말기: '||substring(device_id,1,8) AS msg FROM device_daily WHERE day_cost > 1.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'session:'||id, 0.5::numeric, cost_usd, '⚠️ 단일 통화 비용이 임계를 넘었습니다.'||chr(10)||'통화 #'||id||' '||name||' $'||ROUND(cost_usd::numeric,3)||' (임계 $0.50) · 단말기: '||substring(device_id,1,8) FROM sessions_today WHERE cost_usd > 0.5 UNION ALL SELECT 'global:'||(SELECT day FROM today)||':daily', 5.0::numeric, total, '🚨 전체 일일 사용 비용이 임계를 넘었습니다.'||chr(10)||'오늘 누적 $'||ROUND(total::numeric,3)||' (임계 $5.00) · 전체 모니터링 권장' FROM global_daily WHERE total > 5.0), inserted AS (INSERT INTO cost_alerts (alert_key, threshold_usd, last_value_usd, sent_at) SELECT alert_key, threshold, value, now() FROM candidates ON CONFLICT (alert_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING alert_key) SELECT c.alert_key, c.threshold, c.value, c.msg FROM candidates c JOIN inserted i ON i.alert_key=c.alert_key
